paragraphs.text: Automatically migrate dsh plugins to the new version.
# dsh-migrate-bot
A GitHub Action that moves a DeepSeek Harness plugin to each new `dsh-v*` release. It checks the plu
gin against the release, and when the plugin needs changes, agent sessions review and repair it unti
l the checks pass. The result is proposed to the maintainer as a pull request.
## What it does
For each consumer repository and target release, one migration, which covers the plugin at the repos
itory's root or every plugin below it:
1. boots the unmodified plugin on the release it last worked on and on the target release, to tell a

regression from a pre-existing failure;
2. runs an overlap review (which documented capabilities th
e release now covers) and an extension-point review (which official extension points the plugin shou

ld use), unless the review policy skips them because the unmodified plugin already passes;
3. runs t
he checks — the change cards of the upgrade skill, mechanical (dependency contract, build, typecheck
, tests), boot, web, and the agent-authored end-to-end suite — and repairs the plugin until they pas

s or the attempt limit is reached;
4. proposes a changed plugin on the branch `dsh-migrate/proposal`

, with a pull request and an issue that carries the review and repair reports;
5. after the maintain
er merges the proposal, sends merge reports to the channels the consumer enabled.
A newer release takes over the open proposal instead of opening a second one. Every check runs witho
ut an API key (what a check can read); only the agent sessions spend tokens. The workflow is specifi
ed as a statechart; its states and transitions are in the workflow reference, and the design is in d
ocs/design/workflow.md.
## Install
A plugin repository adds a secret with a DeepSeek API key, a workflow that calls this repository's r
eusable workflow, and optionally a configuration file; docs/operations/install.md has the steps. A c
oding agent working in the plugin repository can do it instead, asking the maintainer what it cannot
find out: give it a prompt such as
> Set up dsh-migrate in this repository by following https://github.com/royenheart/dsh-migrate-bot/b
lob/<release>/docs/operations/install.md#setting-it-up-with-an-agent
with `<release>` the release to pin (what a consumer pins). Every configuration key is in the config
he release to pin (what a consumer pins). Every configuration key is in the configuration reference.
## The state branch and the badge
The Action keeps its record on the branch `dsh-migrate/state`: one event log per migration, the repo
rts a merge report quotes, and `badge.json`. Leave the branch unmerged. The badge shows the newest v
erified release and, when a newer release is in progress, what happened to it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Comment commands
On a proposal's issue or pull request, a commenter the Action admits (who) can comment `/dsh-migrate
status`, `/dsh-migrate report`, and, with a deploy service configured, the preview deployment comma
nds. The command reference lists them. A deploy service is an HTTP service the consumer runs; this r
epository ships a reference implementation and a conformance suite for any other.
## Run it locally
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`check` runs every check on a working tree without an API key. `run` migrates; put the API key in a
gitignored `.secrets.local.json` (see .secrets.local.json.example) or in `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_DSH_MIGRA
TE_BOT`, and pass `--skip-github` so it calls no GitHub API: it opens no proposal, issue or report,
and catches nothing up (starting a migration). It still writes its state branch, and the end-to-end
suite when one is published, to the checkout's `origin` when there is one, and streams its log to a
configured deploy service; in a clone without an `origin` remote both branches stay local. Agent ses
sions need the agent runtime's `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN`. After a run, `node dist/src/cli.js ins
pect --migration 0.2.0` writes `.dsh-migrate/inspect/index.html`: choose two live runs and a session
, read full prompts side by side, select a workflow node or edge to switch the prompt pair, compare
statecharts side by side, see the run state highlighted, and see the run totals and any Harbor link.
Add `--json` to write `inspect.json` for the benchmark site's Run evidence page. With a deploy serv
ice configured, the run uploads that bundle after it finishes; the run page links it, and `EVIDENCE_
figured, the run uploads that bundle after it finishes; the run page links it, and `EVIDENCE_ [长行截断]
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Benchmark
The Action is scored on two task suites, the upgrade skill's and a suite of real migrations across r
elease spans: the full workflow (`pipeline`) and a single agent session (`session`), each with and w
ithout the community upgrade skill. The results, their trends and the diff behind every attempt are
published at royenheart.github.io/dsh-migrate-bot from the records on the `bench/records` branch; th
e evaluation design says what is measured and how.
## Contributing
AGENTS.md holds the rules for working in this repository, and docs/index.md lists every document. Ru
n `npm run gates` and `npm test` before pushing.
